note: One profile per colony or quarter, written from what is on the site. `minutesFromHome` is recomputed from wherever you are.

items.name: Greater Kailash
items.famousFor: M Block and N Block markets: South Delhi's high street of boutiques, cafés and bakeries
items.food: Moti Mahal Delux, where the butter-chicken story is still told
items.walk: M Block → N Block → the Kailash Colony side
items.hidden: The colony parks in the evening, when the uncles walk laps and the kids take over the swings

items.name: Chittaranjan Park
items.famousFor: Delhi's Bengali neighbourhood, and the biggest Durga Puja in the city
items.cafe: Blue Tokai, for when you need a break from the rolls
items.culture: The Kali Mandir on the hill, and the pandals each October
items.food: The evening fish market, fish chops and mishti doi
items.hidden: The adda on the market steps after dark, in Bengali

items.name: Lodhi Colony
items.famousFor: Lodhi Gardens, Khan Market and the murals of the Lodhi Art District
items.cafe: Blue Tokai and Subko Cafe in Meherchand Market
items.culture: Bahrisons Booksellers, Khan Market's bookshop since 1953
items.park: Lodhi Gardens, with fifteenth-century tombs between the joggers
items.unusual: Street murals along the blocks of the 1940s government housing
items.walk: Lodhi Gardens → the mural lanes → Khan Market
items.hidden: The Bara Gumbad mosque in Lodhi Gardens, early, before the walkers

items.name: Nizamuddin
items.famousFor: The dargah of Hazrat Nizamuddin Auliya, Humayun's Tomb and Sunder Nursery
items.cafe: Cafe Lota at the Crafts Museum
items.park: Sunder Nursery, a restored Mughal garden next to Humayun's Tomb
items.food: Kebabs and nihari in the basti lanes
items.walk: Sunder Nursery → Humayun's Tomb → the basti and dargah
items.hidden: Mirza Ghalib's tomb, a short walk from the dargah

items.name: Chandni Chowk & Old Delhi
items.famousFor: Shahjahan's city: the Red Fort, the Jama Masjid and three and a half centuries of bazaars
items.culture: The Red Fort and Gurudwara Sis Ganj
items.food: Karim's, Kallu Nihari, Jalebi Wala and Moti Mahal's first site
items.unusual: The Khari Baoli spice market, Asia's largest
items.walk: Jama Masjid → Dariba Kalan → Chandni Chowk → Khari Baoli
items.hidden: Rooftop views from the spice-market building on Khari Baoli

items.name: Connaught Place
items.famousFor: The colonnaded rings of the 1930s city centre
items.cafe: Indian Coffee House upstairs in Mohan Singh Place, and United Coffee House
items.culture: Agrasen ki Baoli, a stepwell hidden behind the office blocks
items.food: Saravana Bhavan for dosa; Kwality for chole bhature the old way
items.walk: Janpath → the Inner Circle → Agrasen ki Baoli
items.hidden: Gurudwara Bangla Sahib's langar, open to anyone, a short walk west

items.name: Hauz Khas
items.famousFor: A medieval reservoir and madrasa, with a village of bars and boutiques on top of it
items.cafe: Kunzum Travel Cafe — pay what you like
items.park: Deer Park and the lake, behind the village
items.culture: The fourteenth-century madrasa and Firoz Shah's tomb on the water
items.hidden: The ruins at sunset from the lake's far bank

items.name: Saket
items.famousFor: The malls, a free museum of modern Indian art, and a Tughlaq mosque across the road
items.cafe: Blue Tokai, or the bookshop café at Bahrisons
items.culture: Kiran Nadar Museum of Art, free
items.food: Mahabelly for Kerala food; Burma Burma for vegetarian Burmese
items.unusual: Khirki Masjid, a roofed fourteenth-century mosque in the village opposite the malls
items.walk: KNMA → across Press Enclave Marg → Khirki Masjid
items.hidden: The Khirki village lanes behind the mosque

items.name: Malviya Nagar & Eldeco Centre
items.famousFor: Eldeco Centre, a single building on Shivalik Road packed with the evening's bars and restaurants
items.culture: Live music and cocktails at the Piano Man and Arts Room
items.food: 6 Ballygunge Place for Bengali; Hikki for Japanese; the Mission Bay for tacos
items.walk: Begumpur Mosque → Shivalik Road → Eldeco Centre
items.hidden: The Begumpur Mosque, a huge Tughlaq courtyard a few streets away

items.name: Vasant Vihar
items.famousFor: Embassy-quarter calm by day, and Delhi's best cluster of speakeasies by night
items.culture: PVR Priya, the cinema that gave PVR its name
items.food: Tibetan Food Stop for momos and thukpa
items.unusual: The dhabas of JNU next door, chai and arguments until late
items.walk: Basant Lok → D Block Market → dinner, then a bar
items.hidden: PCO, through the phone booth — DM for the week's code

items.name: Saidulajab & Lado Sarai
items.famousFor: Urban villages between Saket and the Qutb, full of galleries, cafés and cheap eats
items.cafe: JugMug Thela for a stand-up chai
items.culture: The Lado Sarai galleries and Altogether Experimental
items.park: The Garden of Five Senses on the ridge
items.food: Mahabelly Canteen for Kerala meals; Ssongchee for bingsu
items.walk: Garden of Five Senses → Saidulajab lanes → Lado Sarai → Qutb at sunset
items.hidden: Mehrauli Archaeological Park, a short walk west, with tombs and step-wells

items.name: Lajpat Nagar & Amar Colony
items.famousFor: South Delhi's biggest everyday bazaar, built by families who came from West Punjab after Partition, and now home to a large Afghan community
items.food: Dolma Aunty's momos in Central Market; Nagpal for chole bhature
items.unusual: Afghan bakeries and kebab shops on the lanes towards Bhogal, with signs in Dari
items.culture: The Japan Foundation's library and free film screenings
items.walk: Central Market → Amar Colony market → Lajpat Nagar IV for Nagpal
items.hidden: Tailors and lace-and-trim shops in the Central Market back lanes, before Diwali and the wedding season

items.name: Defence Colony
items.famousFor: A 1960s colony built for ex-servicemen, with one compact market packed with places to eat
items.bakery: Defence Bakery, for patties and cream rolls
items.food: The original Sagar Ratna, open since 1986, for dosa
items.culture: Mubarak Shah Sayyid's tomb in Kotla Mubarakpur, ten minutes' walk
items.walk: Defence Colony market → Kotla Mubarakpur → the Lodi gumbads by South Extension
items.hidden: Ek Bar upstairs in the market, for cocktails made with Indian ingredients

items.name: Aerocity
items.famousFor: The hotel district by the airport, with Worldmark's restaurants and bars at its centre
items.cafe: Anna Maya at the Andaz, for breakfast before a flight
items.food: Worldmark's walkways: One8 Commune, Dhaba Estd 1986 and dozens more
items.culture: Not much — come for dinner and a drink
items.walk: Aerocity metro → Worldmark → the Andaz for a drink
items.hidden: Juniper Bar's Indian craft gins at the Andaz

items.name: Majnu ka Tilla
items.famousFor: Delhi's Tibetan colony on the Yamuna, settled by refugees in the early 1960s
items.cafe: AMA Cafe, several floors of students and monks
items.food: Laphing, momos and Bhutanese ema datshi at Tara
items.culture: The monastery at the heart of the colony, and the Sikh gurudwara across Ring Road
items.unusual: Laphing, cold mung-bean noodles in chilli oil, which you'll find almost nowhere else in Delhi
items.walk: Ring Road footbridge → main lane → monastery square → AMA Cafe
items.hidden: The Tughlaq-era Wazirabad bridge and Shah Alam's tomb, a short auto ride north along the river
